narrative.overview: A control surface for something you wear: precise, quiet, legible at a glance. The 3D earbuds sit on a stage of faint concentric rings; everything adjustable lives beside it on a console divided by hairlines. One thing is active at a time and it is the only thing that is yellow.
keyCharacteristics: One accent, used only for the active state; colour elsewhere carries meaning.
Ink (dark) default, Bone (light) follows the system; tinted neutrals only.
Display-weight tabular numerals that read like a meter.
Structure from hairlines and spacing, not nested cards.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Yellow marks the single active choice in a group.

rules.name: The Meaning-Not-Decoration Rule
rules.body: Teal and red appear only when they state something.

rules.name: The Sentence-Case Rule
rules.body: No tracked all-caps labels; hierarchy comes from size and weight.

rules.name: The Glass-Has-A-Job Rule
rules.body: Blur only where something sits over the stage rings or a track must read as recessed.

dos: Do let exactly one option per group carry Signal Yellow.
Do keep controls reachable by keyboard with the themed focus ring.
Do animate only in response to an action, plus the one 3D assembly on connect; respect prefers-reduced-motion.
Do write controls as the action or state they set, in sentence case.
Do use tabular numerals for every number.
donts: Don't wrap content in identical rounded cards.
Don't use tracked uppercase labels or eyebrows above headings.
Don't use blur as ambient decoration or a yellow glow.
Don't use pure black or white.
Don't show a setting the model or capability bitmap doesn't expose.
